{{Infobox character|name=Master Halvard|image=Portrait halvard.jpg|house=[[House Ironvale]]|role=Head of house|age=~58|kin=[[Senna Ironvale]] (daughter)|words=What we cannot rebuild owns us.|seat=[[Forge Gap]]}}
'''Master Halvard Ironvale''' is the house's finest engineer in generations — quieter and drier than the house's boastful norm, trusting only what can be repeated. His rationalism has built roads, bridges, and harvests that fed thousands.

Thirty years ago, at the forge, he witnessed something he has never been able to explain. He has been trying to reproduce it under controlled conditions ever since. When conversation nears the inexplicable, he begins counting aloud — measures, weights, distances — like an incantation.
